metadata.title: Epistemic Systems Visual Language
metadata.subtitle: End-to-end agent society map for discovery, proof, governance, and reflection.
metadata.design_rationale: A typed directed graph with a stable preset layout fits epistemic circuits better than a force layout because the agent society has known phases, persistent stores, recurrent control loops, and a process spine that should remain legible across runs.
metadata.universal_binding: The notation ties each agent to universal epistemic roles: grounding, generation, critique, aggregation, persistence, routing, reflection, and controlled recursion.

lanes.label: Grounding
lanes.question: What can be asserted from the source material once theorem bodies, quantifiers, and models are explicit?
lanes.system_role: License and stabilize the inferential material before discovery begins.
lanes.description: Normalize claims, anchor them in source theorems, and control what can be asserted.

lanes.label: Discovery
lanes.question: What bridge object, invariant, abstraction, or route could mediate the current tension?
lanes.system_role: Generate and reshape the conceptual frontier rather than proving everything immediately.
lanes.description: Generate route hypotheses, bridge objects, invariants, and new search branches.

lanes.label: Prove
lanes.question: Which theorem-shaped subgoals, tactics, contradictions, or imports would actually close or block the route?
lanes.system_role: Subject discovery programmes to tactic-structured informal proof pressure.
lanes.description: Attempt tactic-guided informal proofs, critique them, and persist usable results.

lanes.label: Governance
lanes.question: Should the system branch, continue, reopen, defer, or stop?
lanes.system_role: Control recursion, memory, prioritization, and bounded continuation.
lanes.description: Control loops, score progress, reopen promising directions, and avoid unbounded drift.

lanes.label: Reflection
lanes.question: What changed in understanding, what remained hard, and what should an expert inspect next?
lanes.system_role: Turn process state into expert-visible interpretation and public reasoning surfaces.
lanes.description: Synthesize what changed, what persists, and what an expert should inspect next.

node_types.label: Knowledge Store
node_types.meaning: Persistent epistemic memory: statements, proofs, queues, logs, and reusable theorems.
node_types.epistemic_move: Retain and reactivate what has already been grounded or learned.

node_types.label: Normalizer
node_types.meaning: Re-expresses raw statements into typed, licensed, inspectable claims.
node_types.epistemic_move: Type and license material before the rest of the system reasons with it.

node_types.label: Generator
node_types.meaning: Produces candidate routes, abstractions, branches, or proof attempts.
node_types.epistemic_move: Expand the search space by proposing new inferential material.

node_types.label: Aggregator
node_types.meaning: Collects many local results into a ranked or synthesized frontier.
node_types.epistemic_move: Compress many local signals into a coherent frontier or watch state.

node_types.label: Critic
node_types.meaning: Tests soundness, plausibility, fidelity, or adversarial weakness.
node_types.epistemic_move: Apply back-pressure so coherence does not masquerade as evidence.

node_types.label: Controller
node_types.meaning: Routes work across phases, handles loops, and decides when to continue or stop.
node_types.epistemic_move: Govern recursion and decide whether more work is justified.

node_types.label: Publisher
node_types.meaning: Turns process state into expert-facing reports, surfaces, or maps.
node_types.epistemic_move: Expose internal state as an inspectable narrative or surface.

node_types.label: External Source
node_types.meaning: Web or prior-art source used only when local evidence is insufficient and the search gate allows it.
node_types.epistemic_move: Import decisive external structure only when local material is exhausted.

edge_types.label: Grounds
edge_types.meaning: Supplies typed source material, theorem bodies, or licensed evidence.

edge_types.label: Proposes
edge_types.meaning: Generates candidate claims, carriers, proof tasks, or branch programmes.

edge_types.label: Aggregates
edge_types.meaning: Collects many local artefacts into a unified frontier or report.

edge_types.label: Critiques
edge_types.meaning: Evaluates consistency, evidence, plausibility, or tactical discipline.

edge_types.label: Routes
edge_types.meaning: Directs control flow across phases, queues, and search branches.

edge_types.label: Persists
edge_types.meaning: Writes durable memory so the search does not forget what it already learned.

edge_types.label: Imports
edge_types.meaning: Brings external mathematics into InformalMathLib in a reusable normalized form.

edge_types.label: Loops
edge_types.meaning: Feeds reflected or judged state back into discovery and prove as a controlled recursion.

process_spine.title: License Claims
process_spine.question: What is actually assertable from the local theorem bodies?
process_spine.description: The system begins by normalizing raw statements, exposing quantifiers and models, and refusing unlicensed assertions.

process_spine.title: Select Leverage
process_spine.question: Which theorem pair or tension is mathematically leverageful rather than merely central?
process_spine.description: Discovery chooses entrypoints and route candidates using theorem grounding, anti-hub checks, and first kill conditions.

process_spine.title: Form Conceptual Nexus
process_spine.question: What bridge object, abstraction family, or invariant would connect the source and target?
process_spine.description: Bridge planning, abstraction conjecture, and proof sketching turn a raw gap into a coherent discovery programme with explicit proof debt.

process_spine.title: Apply Proof Pressure
process_spine.question: Which subgoals, tactics, contradictions, or external results decide whether the route survives?
process_spine.description: The proof queue and prove cycle turn programmes into tactic-structured attempts, while the critic applies adversarial pressure.

process_spine.title: Govern Recursion
process_spine.question: Should the system branch, continue, reopen, or stop?
process_spine.description: Discovery branches, the work loop, and the high-reward watch prevent both premature stopping and uncontrolled depth-first drift.

process_spine.title: Reflect and Publish
process_spine.question: What changed in understanding, what remains blocked, and what should a mathematician inspect next?
process_spine.description: Expert papers, meta reflection, logs, and reasoning surfaces turn internal control state into inspectable scientific narrative.

nodes.title: Problem KB
nodes.function: Persistent theorem bodies, definitions, axioms, and statement references for a specific problem.
nodes.universal_binding: Material memory: the declarative corpus that licenses all later inference.
nodes.epistemic_move: Retain and reactivate what has already been grounded or learned.
nodes.tooltip: Problem KB: Persistent theorem bodies, definitions, axioms, and statement references for a specific problem.

nodes.title: Theorem-Body Normalizer
nodes.function: Converts raw theorem prose into typed hypotheses, conclusions, quantifier regimes, and assertion licenses.
nodes.universal_binding: Formal normalization: turns text into inspectable inferential units.
nodes.epistemic_move: Type and license material before the rest of the system reasons with it.
nodes.tooltip: Theorem-Body Normalizer: Converts raw theorem prose into typed hypotheses, conclusions, quantifier regimes, and assertion licenses.

nodes.title: InformalMathLib
nodes.function: Problem-scoped memory of proved, disproved, imported, and reusable mathematical results.
nodes.universal_binding: Reusable formal-material memory: local theorem inventory and prior-art cache.
nodes.epistemic_move: Retain and reactivate what has already been grounded or learned.
nodes.tooltip: InformalMathLib: Problem-scoped memory of proved, disproved, imported, and reusable mathematical results.

nodes.title: Prior-Art Pass
nodes.function: Targets external mathematical frameworks or theorems only when local search and InformalMathLib fail to close a decisive gap.
nodes.universal_binding: External grounding: controlled import of prior formal structure.
nodes.epistemic_move: Import decisive external structure only when local material is exhausted.
nodes.tooltip: Prior-Art Pass: Targets external mathematical frameworks or theorems only when local search and InformalMathLib fail to close a decisive gap.

nodes.title: Entrypoint Finder
nodes.function: Selects leverageful statements rather than ontology hubs, using theorem grounding and anti-hub checks.
nodes.universal_binding: Epistemic targeting: where the search should start.
nodes.epistemic_move: Expand the search space by proposing new inferential material.
nodes.tooltip: Entrypoint Finder: Selects leverageful statements rather than ontology hubs, using theorem grounding and anti-hub checks.

nodes.title: Entrypoint Pathfinder
nodes.function: Builds candidate theorem-to-theorem routes together with deltas, first kill conditions, and pathway rationale.
nodes.universal_binding: Inferential path search: plausible routes through the statement space.
nodes.epistemic_move: Expand the search space by proposing new inferential material.
nodes.tooltip: Entrypoint Pathfinder: Builds candidate theorem-to-theorem routes together with deltas, first kill conditions, and pathway rationale.

nodes.title: Proof Connector
nodes.function: Separates graph leverage from mathematical leverage and compresses candidate routes into connectable proof programmes.
nodes.universal_binding: Programme assembly: connect local routes into inspection-ready search units.
nodes.epistemic_move: Compress many local signals into a coherent frontier or watch state.
nodes.tooltip: Proof Connector: Separates graph leverage from mathematical leverage and compresses candidate routes into connectable proof programmes.

nodes.title: Concept Bridge Planner
nodes.function: Posits bridge objects, statement deltas, invariants, and concrete route claims; marks underspecified carriers explicitly.
nodes.universal_binding: Abductive bridge search: identify what object could support the missing inference.
nodes.epistemic_move: Expand the search space by proposing new inferential material.
nodes.tooltip: Concept Bridge Planner: Posits bridge objects, statement deltas, invariants, and concrete route claims; marks underspecified carriers explicitly.

nodes.title: Gap Abstraction Conjecturer
nodes.function: Turns blocked routes into typed conjectural objects, repair abstractions, and breakthrough-family diagnoses.
nodes.universal_binding: Concept formation: move from missing step to missing abstraction type.
nodes.epistemic_move: Expand the search space by proposing new inferential material.
nodes.tooltip: Gap Abstraction Conjecturer: Turns blocked routes into typed conjectural objects, repair abstractions, and breakthrough-family diagnoses.

nodes.title: Proof Sketcher
nodes.function: Builds theorem-shaped informal proof programmes with tactic-friendly subgoals, lemma chains, and failure probes.
nodes.universal_binding: Informal derivation design: what an eventual proof would have to look like.
nodes.epistemic_move: Expand the search space by proposing new inferential material.
nodes.tooltip: Proof Sketcher: Builds theorem-shaped informal proof programmes with tactic-friendly subgoals, lemma chains, and failure probes.

nodes.title: Discovery Cycle
nodes.function: Coordinates discovery, reopens blocked routes, and enqueues search work without repeating exhausted local moves.
nodes.universal_binding: Recursive search control: when and how to continue exploration.
nodes.epistemic_move: Govern recursion and decide whether more work is justified.
nodes.tooltip: Discovery Cycle: Coordinates discovery, reopens blocked routes, and enqueues search work without repeating exhausted local moves.

nodes.title: Discovery Branch Queue
nodes.function: Persistent branch-level memory for distinct discovery patterns, families, attempts, and status transitions.
nodes.universal_binding: Search branch memory: keeps breadth-first discovery from collapsing into a single route.
nodes.epistemic_move: Retain and reactivate what has already been grounded or learned.
nodes.tooltip: Discovery Branch Queue: Persistent branch-level memory for distinct discovery patterns, families, attempts, and status transitions.

nodes.title: Discovery Branch Executor
nodes.function: Executes discovery branches as separate search runs and records what conceptual move each branch actually tested.
nodes.universal_binding: Branch realization: turn a discovery pattern into concrete exploratory work.
nodes.epistemic_move: Expand the search space by proposing new inferential material.
nodes.tooltip: Discovery Branch Executor: Executes discovery branches as separate search runs and records what conceptual move each branch actually tested.

nodes.title: Proof Queue
nodes.function: Persistent queue of self-contained conjectures, route lemmas, and branch-promoted proof tasks.
nodes.universal_binding: Task memory: what remains to be proved, disproved, or blocked.
nodes.epistemic_move: Retain and reactivate what has already been grounded or learned.
nodes.tooltip: Proof Queue: Persistent queue of self-contained conjectures, route lemmas, and branch-promoted proof tasks.

nodes.title: Prove Cycle
nodes.function: Runs tactic-structured informal proofs, critiques each move, and finalizes results as proved, disproved, or blocked.
nodes.universal_binding: Structured informal inference: controlled proof search rather than free-form prose.
nodes.epistemic_move: Expand the search space by proposing new inferential material.
nodes.tooltip: Prove Cycle: Runs tactic-structured informal proofs, critiques each move, and finalizes results as proved, disproved, or blocked.

nodes.title: End-to-End Proof Critic
nodes.function: Assesses whether local proof state closes the main claim, respects assumptions, and survives adversarial scrutiny.
nodes.universal_binding: Global proof judgment: whether the current route is actually becoming a complete solution.
nodes.epistemic_move: Apply back-pressure so coherence does not masquerade as evidence.
nodes.tooltip: End-to-End Proof Critic: Assesses whether local proof state closes the main claim, respects assumptions, and survives adversarial scrutiny.

nodes.title: High-Reward Watch
nodes.function: Detects major subresults that justify bounded continuation rather than an early budget stop.
nodes.universal_binding: Reward-sensitive control: protect genuinely valuable local breakthroughs from premature termination.
nodes.epistemic_move: Compress many local signals into a coherent frontier or watch state.
nodes.tooltip: High-Reward Watch: Detects major subresults that justify bounded continuation rather than an early budget stop.

nodes.title: Work Loop
nodes.function: Alternates discovery and prove, invokes meta at key stop points, and decides whether the research programme keeps going.
nodes.universal_binding: Outer epistemic control: the recursive agent society seen as one system.
nodes.epistemic_move: Govern recursion and decide whether more work is justified.
nodes.tooltip: Work Loop: Alternates discovery and prove, invokes meta at key stop points, and decides whether the research programme keeps going.

nodes.title: Expert Paper Generator
nodes.function: Turns the live route and its proof debt into a human-inspectable research paper narrative.
nodes.universal_binding: Expert-facing synthesis: convert internal search state into mathematical exposition.
nodes.epistemic_move: Expose internal state as an inspectable narrative or surface.
nodes.tooltip: Expert Paper Generator: Turns the live route and its proof debt into a human-inspectable research paper narrative.

nodes.title: Meta Reflection
nodes.function: Reflects on why the problem is hard, what conceptual shift occurred, and whether the process is learning or merely organizing.

nodes.epistemic_move: Apply back-pressure so coherence does not masquerade as evidence.
nodes.tooltip: Meta Reflection: Reflects on why the problem is hard, what conceptual shift occurred, and whether the process is learning or merely organizing.

nodes.title: Reasoning Logs
nodes.function: Stores fine-grained provenance of each agent action, prompt context, and emitted artefact.

nodes.epistemic_move: Retain and reactivate what has already been grounded or learned.

nodes.tooltip: Reasoning Surfaces: Publishes dashboards, maps, papers, and diagrams that expose the current state of the agent society to experts.

edges.tooltip: Ground discovery in typed claims: Discovery starts only after statement bodies, quantifiers, and models are explicit.

edges.title: Persist normalized results

edges.tooltip: Assemble candidate routes: Pathways are compressed into connected proof programmes.

edges.tooltip: Pass connected routes to bridge search: Only mathematically leverageful route programmes proceed to bridge planning.

edges.tooltip: Promote discovery programmes: Successful branch outcomes reopen theorem-shaped proof tasks.
